lessons.title: PROTECT THE GIFT
lessons.body: An overnight indicated double on a 1-lot is a gift. From this stamp forward, +50% on a 1-lot must REALIZE PROFIT or become a PROTECTED RUNNER with a published premium floor. +100% is a harvest or a tightened floor — not an unprotected hold into the cash open. This lesson is forward-only. It does not rewrite Trade Zero.
